meaning:
§ Tartak = "prince of darkness"
one of the deities of the Avite people of Samaria
according to tradition, worshipped under the form of an ass

elsewhere.note: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
